raw.rationale: AST-1306 is a dual EGFR/ERBB2 inhibitor, so selective killing is most plausible in lineages with strong EGFR/ERBB2 dependence, especially EGFR-mutant or ERBB2-amplified lung and breast cancers; most other lineages lack such oncogene addiction and should show little selective effect at 2.5 µM. Published PRISM-type screens generally show EGFR inhibitors as selective mainly for EGFR/ERBB2-driven subsets rather than broad lineage-wide effects.
